'''Greater demon berserkers''' are monsters that can be found in the [[Wilderness]] by the shore east of the [[Demonic Ruins]]. These demons have less health than their [[Greater demon berserker (The Zamorakian Undercity)|Zamorakian Undercity counterparts]] and are susceptible to both stun and poison.

Like their fellow demons encountered in the elite dungeon, these monsters are capable of pathing around obstacles to reach the player and can deal immense amounts of damage with their melee attacks. They may be killed for a [[Demons (Slayer assignment)|demon]] or [[Greater demons (Slayer assignment)|greater demon task]] for more slayer experience. 

Although they attack with a fireball animation, they only deal melee damage. However, they are much stronger than most other demons. Players struggling to kill the demons can use a safespot at the nearby [[bloodwood tree]], as the pathing is too small for the demon to get through. They should not be confused for the nearby and similar-looking [[Greater demon ash lord|ash lords]]; the berserker's horns are shorter and point forward, while the ash lord's are longer and point backwards.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=patch|update=New Slayer Mobs & Premier Refresh - This Week In RuneScape|date=4 November 2024}}
** Reduced Slayer XP from Wilderness greater demon variants to reduce the impact of them warping lower level Slayer; they now give 0.04 XP per HP rather than 0.065 XP per HP.
*** Also removed their additional killcount cost to make them favor Slayer wildcards slightly less. For example, a greater demon ashlord will now reduce normal Slayer count by 1 rather than 8.

* {{UL|type=hidden|update=Hidden updates|date=4 March 2024}}
** The Strong Guard buff has effectively been replaced by the damage potential system, and monsters which previously had this buff no longer have it.
*** Greater demon berserker

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Spring Festival & Frank's Free Chest 2 - This Week In RuneScape|date=3 April 2023}}
** Adjusted the spawn location of demons at the bloodwood tree west of the Dragonkin Laboratory as they often interfered with players interacting with the tree.

* {{UL|type=hidden|update=Wilderness Ninja Strike! - This Week In RuneScape|date=13 March 2023}}
** Greater demon berserkers now count as 8 kills for slayer tasks.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Wilderness Ninja Strike! - This Week In RuneScape|date=13 March 2023}}
** Moved the berserkers from the area near the level 44 Wilderness obelisk to area outside the Dragonkin Laboratory.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Free To Play Area Graphical Updates - This Week In RuneScape|date=5 September 2022}}
** Updated the Greater Demons in Wilderness:
*** Reduced health of berserkers from 160,000 to 110,000.
*** Removed stun and poison immunity.
*** Added drops.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Wilderness Reborn & New Quest - This Week In RuneScape|date=1 August 2022}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* Alongside the ash lord, the greater demon berserker are the first monsters to drop necronium salvage.
* This type of greater demon used to possess the [[Strong guard (status)|Strong guard]] status, which made the players' attacks incapable of missing and made their [[Ability damage|damage]] dependent on their [[Hit chance|accuracy]]; this was effectively replaced by the damage potential system on [[4 March]] [[2024]].
